items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He played with you too? [INTERVIEWEE] Well, uh, Kev, didn't he?

ctx.x: He was on the play with Sir Hicks.

Yeah. Let me ask you a couple of names, see if you remember his father. Do you remember Charles McCurdy? Charles McCurdy, yeah. He used to be with Roeby Show's orchestra. Uh huh. He played with you too?
